minutes.headline: Design committee voted 5-2 to take no position on the Article 7 advisory vote on demolishing TC Passios.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed a draft RFP/RFQ for a design consultant, using Franklin's school RFQ as a model, and agreed space needs, PAC and storage questions must be settled first. One member offered to build a cost spreadsheet from the Taylor and Burns numbers. It then voted 5-2 to take no position on Article 7, set the next meeting for December 7, and adjourned.

votes.motion: Approve the October 5th meeting minutes (one member abstained).
Take no position on Article 7, the advisory vote on demolishing TC Passios, and leave discussion to town meeting.
votes.outcome: first roll call: yes votes from chair, Greg, Tony, Laura and Tom; Chris voted no; Tony then retracted

votes.motion: Second roll call on taking no position on Article 7.

budget_items.topic: Taylor and Burns cost estimates (per square foot, addition)
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair noted the per-square-foot figure for a new addition may be inflated by a basement. The Taylor and Burns numbers were proposed as the base for a rough cost comparison.
The chair said the public could only be given a wide range, and worried only the top number would register.
A member said the demolition estimate is not complete but is roughly in a stated range; it is not in the article.
Members discussed applying an annual escalation percentage to the older estimates.
A member said an owner's project manager is legally required once a project passes a set dollar threshold.

budget_items.topic: Roof work triggering ADA upgrades at TCP
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said roof work above an exemption limit triggers ADA upgrades.

decisions.decision: Table the RFP discussion; the chair and Greg will work together on a summary.
Greg will circulate a spreadsheet of rough costs for options within about two weeks.
Tony will contact the PAC committee, which meets on the 9th, about getting on its agenda.
The committee will pass its earlier TCP motions back to the select board.
Next meeting set for December 7 at 5:30.

what_happened.line: The committee voted 5-2 to take no position on the Article 7 advisory vote on demolishing TC Passios, leaving discussion to town meeting.
A first roll call on Article 7 was interrupted when one member retracted a yes vote; a second roll call produced the 5-2 result.
The committee tabled the draft RFP/RFQ for a design consultant; the chair and one member will write a summary.
One member will circulate a spreadsheet of rough option costs within about two weeks, built from the Taylor and Burns numbers.
The committee will pass its earlier TCP motions back to the select board and set its next meeting for December 7 at 5:30.

why_it_matters: Article 7 is an advisory vote at town meeting on demolishing TC Passios, and residents will decide it without a recommendation from this committee.
The design consultant, space needs and cost comparison are still unsettled, so no cost for the consolidation options has been put to the public, and the chair noted only a wide range could be given.
